desc.en: A feather dropped by birds flying over the mountains. It's said in folklore that the cry of mountain birds will bring rain, and is often used in rain rituals and prayers.
desc.ja: 山を越えて飛ぶ鳥たちの落とした羽根。山鳥たちが騒ぐと雨が降るという民間伝承があり、雨乞いの道具としても使われる

desc.en: Effect: Wait time after using item is shortened by 20％. Power is reduced by a small amount in exchange.
desc.ja: 効果：アイテム使用時のＷＴの戻り値が、２０％短縮される。代わりに、威力が少しだけ低下する
